authority: companion artifact; not a ledger record, certificate, performance claim, novelty finding, or status transition

scope.question: Does the normal-basis window factor base V_nb on a Koblitz curve keep the per-attempt solve cost of the polynomial-basis base V_poly, so that the Frobenius gives a free per-relation gain?
scope.target_count: toy targets per cell, as frozen in EXP-FROB-fc007f
scope.parameter_boundary: Koblitz y^2+xy=x^3+a x^2+1 over F_(2^n), n in {11,13,17,19,23}, m in {2,3}, k in {k0,k0+1}; nothing at n=131

source.ambient_group_order: h r, h in {2,4}, r prime (pilot table)

subgroup.generator: per cell, by the frozen rule
subgroup.target: seeded targets in the order-r subgroup

transformation.induced_group_map: multiplication by mu on the order-r subgroup, mu a root of X^2 - t X + 2 mod r

junction_compatibility: tau(V_nb) is the window shifted by one position, so only conjugates landing back in V_nb are usable relations
typed_path.weakest_open_obligation: computational_advantage: whether the V_nb descended system solves at V_poly cost (measured by EXP-FROB-fc007f)

evidence: standard: Frobenius is an endomorphism of a curve defined over F_2
analysis/ecdlp2m-iteration-20261009/tau-factor-base-pilot/README.md (tau = mu verified on random points of each pilot curve)

subgroup_preservation.scope: order-r subgroup; tau acts as multiplication by mu

evidence: a relation for tau(R) is the image of a relation for R; mu is known per curve

destination_solver_applicability.scope: the same WDSat build and closure eliminator must run on V_nb systems; checked by C-PLANT

computational_advantage.scope: measured by EXP-FROB-fc007f: R(nb/poly) and D_W

scaling_support.scope: no claim beyond n <= 23; the whole Frobenius lever is capped at log2(131) = 7.03 bits

novelty_within_boundary.scope: normal-basis window solve cost not found in the program's records

representation_checks.endomorphism_orbit_costs: usable conjugates per relation measured by the pilot: about 1.5-1.9 of n at m=2, 1.1-1.5 at m=3 (exploratory)

cost_comparison.workload: one decomposition attempt per target and arm
cost_comparison.units: WDSat conflicts (primary), closure degree D_W and columns
cost_comparison.uncertainty: bootstrap CI of the paired median ratio R; A/A spread from N0

controls.coordinate_isomorphism: N0: V_poly re-encoded in a random field basis (comparison C-aa-basis)
controls.matched_random_destination: V_rand: size-matched random k-dimensional subspace (comparison C-nb-rand)
controls.transported_vs_reselected_data: targets drawn once per cell before any arm runs and shared by every arm
null_and_known_false: C-PLANT planted decomposable targets must be found by every arm
additional: identity-only relation accounting against tau-conjugate accounting (comparison C-tau-yield)

families: Koblitz curves over F_(2^n), n prime
